description: This file contains unit tests for AES encryption, key wrapping, and related cryptographic functions in BoringSSL's FIPS module, including test vectors, Wycheproof tests, and ABI compatibility checks.

methods.name: TestRaw
methods.description: Tests raw AES encryption and decryption with vectors from test data.

methods.name: TestKeyWrap
methods.description: Tests AES key wrapping and unwrapping with default IV.

methods.name: TestKeyWrapWithPadding
methods.description: Tests AES key wrapping and unwrapping with padding.

methods.name: TestVectors
methods.description: Runs test vectors for AES and key wrapping.

methods.name: WycheproofKeyWrap
methods.description: Runs Wycheproof test vectors for AES key wrap.

methods.name: WycheproofKeyWrapWithPadding
methods.description: Runs Wycheproof test vectors for padded AES key wrap.

methods.name: WrapBadLengths
methods.description: Tests AES wrap function with invalid input lengths.

methods.name: InvalidKeySize
methods.description: Tests setting AES keys with invalid sizes.

methods.name: VPAESToBSAESConvert
methods.description: Converts VPAES keys to BSAES format for ABI testing.
